name: boringproxy Self-Hosted Reverse Proxy
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted reverse proxy and client for publishing local web services over HTTPS with a web management interface; no software licensing fee or vendor-imposed request quota.
watch_out: Requires your own reachable server, network, domain/DNS configuration, TLS and operational security. Hosting, domain registration and optional third-party integrations may cost money; no free managed tunneling service is included. Keep authentication and exposure rules configured securely.
